Kept from the 2026-07-29 entry, because both lessons still hold: the missing-Get-RosterIgnoredIds fingerprint is what misled the inbound #203 investigation -- that alarm was true and about THIS repo, but surfaced inside a life-hub session, which is why the checks now name the repo a finding is about. And the inventory is deliberately left un-pre-filled while lenses are still absent, because this register records what a consumer HAS: claiming a lens early makes the check report 'registered extension(s) missing', turning the register itself into a false alarm. NOT MEASURED IN THIS PASS: the version drift and the 3.1.2 shared-script cache noted above -- this branch corrected the plugin ids and nothing else, so anything here about how far behind they are is as old as its own sentence. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (#1524): localCheckout is now a LIST of relative candidates rather than one string, because the layout genuinely differs per machine and no single value is true on both. Measured on two machines, both holding both BWJ checkouts: on one the source checkout and a 'bwjecommerce' folder are siblings, giving ../../bwjecommerce/<repo>; on the other the source checkout sits one folder deeper, alongside a 'GitHub' folder that holds 'bwjecommerce', giving ../../GitHub/bwjecommerce/<repo>. The recorded '../../davekokbwj/<repo>' resolves on neither. WHY THIS IS ITS OWN DEFECT AND NOT A TYPO: a path that does not resolve is not reported as wrong, it is reported as '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' -- a sentence that ASSERTS an absence which was false, exits 0, and suppresses the entire connector block. On the machine #1524 was measured from, that one skip covered four [INFO] lines about retired plugin ids and a drift check reading 26 missing agent-defs, none of which the machine could see. The check now takes the first candidate present here and names all of them when none is, so a register stale about a machine's layout can be told from a checkout that is genuinely absent. NOT MEASURED: whether a third machine carries a third layout. The field is additive, so recording one is appending a string. The 2026-08-09 sentence above -- 'the localCheckout path is unrelated and stays correct, since the local folder genuinely is davekokbwj/' -- keeps its wording, because it is a dated measurement and rewriting one to match today's answer is the defect #952 was made of. It is simply no longer true: davekokbwj/ is on neither machine.
